observations: Electronic keyboard wrapped in clear plastic film.
Brand 'YAMAHA' is visible on the control panel in photo 0.
Control panel features a small LCD screen, buttons, and knobs.
The keyboard has 49 keys (black and white).
The item is resting on a white leather-like surface.
Watermark 'HERITAGE REAL ESTATE' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it requires a video of the unit powered on and playing.

risks.risk: The LCD screen may be cracked or have dead pixels.
risks.proof: A photo of the screen while the keyboard is powered on.

risks.risk: Individual keys may be unresponsive or 'sticky'.
risks.proof: A video of a chromatic scale being played across all keys.

risks.risk: The power adapter may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the power adapter and its connection to the keyboard.

risks.risk: The internal battery may be dead or unable to hold a charge.
risks.proof: A photo of the battery indicator or a video showing it powering on without the AC adapter.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the keyboard powered on with the LCD screen displaying.
Video of the keyboard being played to confirm all keys and the screen work.
Photo of the power adapter and any included cables.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
